//| echo: false
// Preset stories (set both sliders at once). Story 1 is the default slider state.
pe_toy_presets = {
  const zh = LANG === "zh"
  const presets = [
    [zh ? "情形 1：B 换了估计" : "Story 1: B changed its estimate", 0.5, 0],
    [zh ? "情形 2：B 改进了因子" : "Story 2: B improved its factor", 1, 1],
    [zh ? "重置：两模型相同" : "Reset: identical models", 1, 0]
  ]
  const set = (input, x) => { input.value = x; input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })) }
  const wrap = html`<div role="group" aria-label="${zh ? "预设情形" : "Preset stories"}" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin:0 0 .6rem"></div>`
  for (const [label, keep, tilt] of presets) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">${label}</button>`
    b.onclick = () => { set(viewof pe_toy_keep, keep); set(viewof pe_toy_tilt, tilt) }
    wrap.append(b)
  }
  return wrap
}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Illustrative numbers only (not estimates). Five stocks, one factor, monthly percent.
pe_toy_stocks = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
pe_toy_stockName = (i) => LANG === "zh" ? `股票 ${i}` : `Stock ${i}`
pe_toy_betaA = [0.6, 0.9, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5]
pe_toy_premium = 0.5
pe_toy_extra = [0.40, -0.20, 0.10, -0.30, 0.25]
// At tilt = 1, B's exposures tilt fully toward A's stock-specific tilt, so one factor spans A's estimate
pe_toy_shift = pe_toy_extra.map((e) => 2 * e)
pe_toy_betaB = pe_toy_betaA.map((b, i) => b + pe_toy_tilt * pe_toy_shift[i])
pe_toy_meanA = pe_toy_betaA.map((b, i) => b * pe_toy_premium + pe_toy_extra[i])
pe_toy_meanB = pe_toy_betaA.map((b, i) => b * pe_toy_premium + pe_toy_keep * pe_toy_extra[i])
// Equal-stock projection of an estimate onto the span of one exposure vector
pe_toy_split = (beta, mean) => {
  const bb = beta.reduce((s, b) => s + b * b, 0), bm = beta.reduce((s, b, i) => s + b * mean[i], 0)
  const factor = beta.map((b) => b * bm / bb)
  return { factor, intercept: mean.map((m, i) => m - factor[i]) }
}
pe_toy_rms = (r) => 100 * Math.sqrt(r.reduce((s, x) => s + x * x, 0) / r.length)   // percent -> basis points
pe_toy_cell = (beta, mean) => pe_toy_rms(pe_toy_split(beta, mean).intercept)
pe_toy_AA = pe_toy_cell(pe_toy_betaA, pe_toy_meanA)
pe_toy_BB = pe_toy_cell(pe_toy_betaB, pe_toy_meanB)
pe_toy_BA = pe_toy_cell(pe_toy_betaB, pe_toy_meanA)
pe_toy_AB = pe_toy_cell(pe_toy_betaA, pe_toy_meanB)
pe_toy_mA = LANG === "zh" ? "模型 A" : "Model A"
pe_toy_mB = LANG === "zh" ? "模型 B" : "Model B"
pe_toy_pF = LANG === "zh" ? "因子部分" : "Factor part"
pe_toy_pI = LANG === "zh" ? "阿尔法成分" : "Alpha component"
pe_toy_rows = [[pe_toy_mA, pe_toy_betaA, pe_toy_meanA], [pe_toy_mB, pe_toy_betaB, pe_toy_meanB]].flatMap(([m, beta, mean]) => {
  const s = pe_toy_split(beta, mean)
  return pe_toy_stocks.flatMap((st, i) => [
    { model: m, stock: st, part: pe_toy_pF, value: s.factor[i] },
    { model: m, stock: st, part: pe_toy_pI, value: s.intercept[i] }
  ])
})
pe_toy_totals = [[pe_toy_mA, pe_toy_meanA], [pe_toy_mB, pe_toy_meanB]].flatMap(([m, mean]) => pe_toy_stocks.map((st, i) => ({ model: m, stock: st, value: mean[i] })))
```

  ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "示意图：预期收益估计拆成因子部分与阿尔法成分" : "Illustrative example: expected-return estimates split into a factor part and an alpha component",

  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.muted }),
    Plot.barY(pe_toy_rows, { fx: "model", x: "stock", y: "value", fill: "part", title: (d) => `${d.model}, ${pe_toy_stockName(d.stock)}\n${d.part}: ${d.value.toFixed(2)}%` }),
    Plot.dot(pe_toy_totals, { fx: "model", x: "stock", y: "value", fill: "white", stroke: "black", r: 3.5, title: (d) => `${d.model}, ${pe_toy_stockName(d.stock)}\n${LANG === "zh" ? "预期收益估计合计" : "Total estimate"}: ${d.value.toFixed(2)}%` })
  ]
})

    : `Own alphas: ${fmt1(pe_toy_AA)} bp for A, ${fmt1(pe_toy_BB)} bp for B. Change only the factor (A's estimate held fixed): ${fmt1(pe_toy_AA)} → ${fmt1(pe_toy_BA)} bp. Change only the estimate (A's factor held fixed): ${fmt1(pe_toy_AA)} → ${fmt1(pe_toy_AB)} bp. Illustrative numbers, not the paper's data.`}</p>`
